question: What is the meaning of waste mass after taking recyclable reusable portion in relation to sustainability properties?
data_point: waste mass after taking recyclable reusable portion
description: The meaning of waste mass after taking recyclable reusable portion in relation to sustainability properties is that it represents the portion of materials that cannot be recycled or reused at the end of the building's life cycle. This waste mass highlights the importance of efficient material handling and disposal practices to minimize environmental impact and promote sustainability in construction projects.
